commentTranslate.description: This extension helps developers translate comments, strings, code hints, error messages, and variable names in their code.
commentTranslate.command.toggleDocumentB: Toggle comment browsing mode for the current document
commentTranslate.command.translateForCop: Translate selected text and display in GitHub Copilot Chat
commentTranslate.configuration.concise: Concise mode.If on, only pressing Ctrl or Command will trigger floating translation
commentTranslate.configuration.source: Translate service source. Built-in sources: Google, Bing, DeepL, Copilot (VS Code language models), TranSmart. Use the "Change translate source" command to pick one, including sources provided by other extensions.
commentTranslate.configuration.markdownS: When parsing Markdown code blocks, use TextMate scope matching as a fallback after fenced-code detection.
commentTranslate.configuration.hoverShow: Show the Comment Translate toolbar (replace, merge lines, change source) at the top of translation hovers.
commentTranslate.configuration.mutualTra: Enable mutual translate. When enabled, if the detected language of the input text matches the target language, the translation direction will be swapped automatically.
commentTranslate.configuration.fallbackS: Translate sources tried in order after `#commentTranslate.source#` fails, for example `["Copilot", "Bing"]`. Built-in sources only: `Google`, `Bing`, `DeepL`, `Copilot`, `TranSmart`. Avoid `Google` in the chain: its 500-character limit shrinks the request size of every source.
commentTranslate.configuration.languageM: Language model used by the `Copilot` source. Set it with the **Comment Translate: Select Language Model** command. Empty uses the first GitHub Copilot model.
